Thanks Kim / Alex — pulling together a slightly more detailed milestone grid and a short validation checklist so we have concrete acceptance criteria. Draft below — please confirm feasibility and owners.

Detailed milestone grid (proposed):
1) Kickoff & discovery (Week of May 3) — Deliverables: shared runsheet, contact list, test dataset sample
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (CS)
   - Knotfield owner: Rahul Sharma (TBD)
   - Acceptance: kickoff minutes + runsheet uploaded to shared Drive

2) API contract review & schema validation (May 4–14) — Deliverables: signed API contract doc, mock payload exchange
   - Redwood owner: Jonas Weber (Eng)
   - Knotfield owner: Rahul Sharma
   - Acceptance: automated schema checks pass (+1 manual sample)

3) Staging data ingestion & mapping (May 21–28) — Deliverables: staging dataset ingested, mapping matrix complete
   - Redwood owner: Jonas Weber
   - Knotfield owner: Rahul Sharma
   - Acceptance: record counts match, no mapping errors > 0.1%

4) E2E validation, perf run, and security signoff (June 1–4) — Deliverables: E2E test report, perf metrics, security checklist signed
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole / Security (liaison)
   - Knotfield owner: Alex Ruiz / Priya Menon
   - Acceptance: latency/perf within agreed SLO, security questionnaire closed

5) Production cutover (June 10–12) — Deliverables: cutover playbook executed, roll-back tested
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole
   - Knotfield owner: Rahul Sharma
   - Acceptance: successful smoke tests in prod window

Risks / dependencies:
- SOC2 evidence and security answers (Priya to deliver)
- Network allowlist windows (Knotfield infra needs to confirm maintenance blackout on May 20)
- Internal resource availability for perf run (we'll hold a soft hold on June 1–4)

Action items before kickoff:
- Knotfield to confirm integration owner (name + contact) — Alex/Priya
- Knotfield to upload SOC2 evidence or provide link — Priya
- Knotfield to confirm firewall/IP allowlist with dates — Rahul when assigned

Propose weekly 30-minute standing from May 5 on Tuesdays for status (30 min) — happy to shift if needed.

I'll prepare the E2E test checklist and share as a separate Drive doc by close of day Friday.
